metadata.source_description: Educational ERCOT-derived abstraction for classroom exercises; values are illustrative, schematic, and not operational data.
model_limitations: Thirty-two schematic buses and forty-eight representative corridors are teaching abstractions, not official ERCOT topology or geographic/substation data.
Six-period headroom, corridor capacities, prices, and IT value are illustrative rather than forecasts, market settlements, or operating limits.
The model uses linear capacity limits, simplified generator dispatch, and bounded deterministic curtailment recourse; it does not represent AC power flow, losses, contingencies, or unit commitment.

presentation.title: ERCOT teaching network
presentation.disclaimer: Schematic classroom abstraction; not operational ERCOT data or an interconnection study.

legend.selected: Resource selected by the active teaching plan

tutorial_hints: Start with one bus and inspect its headroom in each of the six periods.
Trace a path through corridors; shared corridor capacity is consumed across selected sites.
Use constrained and unconstrained resources to compare feasibility and score trade-offs.
